50035-wives-of-the-prime-ministers-1844-.creator: Elizabeth Lee
50035-wives-of-the-prime-ministers-1844-.description: A book by Elizabeth Lee. ed before their husbands actually attained the Premiership; therefore they can scarcely be logically called wives of Prime Ministers. But it has been thought well to include a memoir of Lady Caroline Lamb, because the facts of her picturesque and agitated career are not accessible in any one complete account, and because it throws a good deal of light on the social and domestic aspects of political life in the early nineteenth century.

arxiv-2005-10659.title: RuBQ: A Russian Dataset for Question Answering over Wikidata
arxiv-2005-10659.creator: Vladislav Korablinov, Pavel Braslavski
arxiv-2005-10659.description: Abstract The paper presents RuBQ , the first Russian knowledge base question answering (KBQA) dataset. The high-quality dataset consists of 1,500 Russian questions of varying complexity, their English machine translations, SPARQL queries to Wikidata, reference answers, as well as a Wikidata sample of triples containing entities with Russian labels.

arxiv-2203-16752.title: Higher-order boundary layers and regularity for Stokes systems over rough boundaries
arxiv-2203-16752.creator: Mitsuo Higaki, Jinping Zhuge
arxiv-2203-16752.description: Abstract Abstract. In this paper, we study the large-scale boundary regularity for the Stokes system in periodically oscillating John domains. Our main contribution is the construction of boundary layer correctors of arbitrary order. This is a significant generalization of the known results restricted to the first and second orders.

arxiv-2306-12604.title: Consecutive Inertia Drift of Autonomous RC Car via Primitive-based Planning and Data-driven Control
arxiv-2306-12604.creator: Yiwen Lu, Bo Yang, Jiayun Li, Yihan Zhou, Hongshuai Chen, Yilin Mo
arxiv-2306-12604.description: Abstract Inertia drift is an aggressive transitional driving maneuver, which is challenging due to the high nonlinearity of the system and the stringent requirement on control and planning performance. This paper presents a solution for the consecutive inertia drift of an autonomous RC car based on primitive-based planning and data-driven control.

arxiv-2308-01857.title: iEDA: An Open-Source Intelligent Physical Implementation Toolkit and Library
arxiv-2308-01857.creator: Xingquan Li 1,11 1 , Simin Tao 1 , Zengrong Huang 1 , Shijian Chen 1,2,13 , Zhisheng Zeng 1,2,13 , Liwei Ni 1,2,13 , Zhipeng Huang 1 , Chunan Zhuang 1 , Hongxi Wu 4,3 , Weiguo Li 11,3 , Xueyan Zhao 2,13,1 , He Liu 5,1 , Shuaiying Long 1 , Wei He 1 , Bojun Liu 1 , Sifeng Gan 1 , Zihao Yu 2,3 , Tong L
arxiv-2308-01857.description: Abstract Open-source EDA shows promising potential in unleashing EDA innovation and lowering the cost of chip design. This paper presents an open-source EDA project, iEDA, aiming for building a basic infrastructure for EDA technology evolution and closing the industrial-academic gap in the EDA area.

arxiv-2311-13786.title: Supercurrent-carrying supersolid in spin-orbit-coupled Bose-Einstein condensates
arxiv-2311-13786.creator: Hao Lyu, Yuanyuan Chen, Qizhong Zhu, Yongping Zhang
arxiv-2311-13786.description: Abstract One of brilliant achievements in spin-orbit-coupled Bose-Einstein condensates is the discovery and observation of the supersolid stripe states. So far, all studied supersolid stripe states do not carry supercurrent. In this work, we reveal the existence of novel supercurrent-carrying supersolids in spin-orbit-coupled Bose-Einstein condensates.

arxiv-2405-00221.title: Measuring the convexity of compact sumsets with the Schneider non-convexity index
arxiv-2405-00221.creator: Mark Meyer
arxiv-2405-00221.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Mark Meyer. In recent work, Franck Barthe and Mokshay Madiman introduced the concept of the Lyusternik region, denoted by Λ n ​ ( m ) \Lambda_{n}(m) , to better understand volumes of sumsets. They gave a characterization of Λ n ​ ( 2 ) \Lambda_{n}(2) (the volumes of compact sets in ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} when at most m = 2 m=2 sets are added together) and proved that Lebesgue measure satisfies a fractional superadditive property.

arxiv-2407-20012.title: Investigation of kaonic atom optical potential by the high precision data of kaonic 3 He and 4 He atoms
arxiv-2407-20012.creator: J. Yamagata-Sekihara, Y. Iizawa, D. Jido, N. Ikeno, T. Hashimoto, S. Okada, S. Hirenzaki
arxiv-2407-20012.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by J. Yamagata-Sekihara, Y. Iizawa, D. Jido, N. Ikeno, T. Hashimoto, S. Okada, S. Hirenzaki. We investigate kaonic atom optical potentials of 3 He and 4 He phenomenologically based on the latest high precision data of the 2 ​ p 2p states of the kaonic atoms in helium (J-PARC E62). We consider a simple phenomenological form for the optical potential proportional to the nuclear density distributions and clarify the meanings and implications of the data by determining the potential parameters by the latest data.

arxiv-2408-02877.title: First Indication of Solar 8 B Neutrinos via Coherent Elastic Neutrino-Nucleus Scattering with XENONnT
arxiv-2408-02877.creator: E. Aprile, J. Aalbers, K. Abe, S. Ahmed Maouloud, L. Althueser, B. Andrieu, E. Angelino, D. Antón Martin, F. Arneodo, L. Baudis, M. Bazyk, L. Bellagamba, R. Biondi, A. Bismark, K. Boese, A. Brown, G. Bruno, R. Budnik, C. Cai, C. Capelli, J. M. R. Cardoso, A. P. Cimental Chávez, A. P. Colijn, J. Conr
arxiv-2408-02877.description: Abstract We present the first measurement of nuclear recoils from solar 8 B neutrinos via coherent elastic neutrino-nucleus scattering with the XENONnT dark matter experiment. The central detector of XENONnT is a low-background, two-phase time projection chamber with a 5.9 t sensitive liquid xenon target. A blind analysis with an exposure of 3.

arxiv-2410-04609.title: VISTA: A Visual and Textual Attention Dataset for Interpreting Multimodal Models
arxiv-2410-04609.creator: Harshit, Tolga Tasdizen
arxiv-2410-04609.description: Abstract The recent developments in deep learning (DL) led to the integration of natural language processing (NLP) with computer vision, resulting in powerful integrated Vision and Language Models (VLMs). Despite their remarkable capabilities, these models are frequently regarded as black boxes within the machine learning research community.

arxiv-2504-08782.title: Embedding Hidden Adversarial Capabilities in Pre-Trained Diffusion Models
arxiv-2504-08782.creator: Lucas Beerens, Desmond J. Higham
arxiv-2504-08782.description: Abstract We introduce a new attack paradigm that embeds hidden adversarial capabilities directly into diffusion models via fine-tuning, without altering their observable behavior or requiring modifications during inference. Unlike prior approaches that target specific images or adjust the generation process to produce adversarial outputs, our method integrates adversarial functionality into the model itself.

arxiv-2505-04813.title: WIR3D: Visually-Informed and Geometry-Aware 3D Shape Abstraction
arxiv-2505-04813.creator: Richard Liu, Daniel Fu, Noah Tan, Itai Lang, Rana Hanocka
arxiv-2505-04813.description: Abstract In this work we present WIR3D, a technique for abstracting 3D shapes through a sparse set of visually meaningful curves in 3D. We optimize the parameters of Bézier curves such that they faithfully represent both the geometry and salient visual features (e.g. texture) of the shape from arbitrary viewpoints.

arxiv-2505-21908.title: Reinforcement Learning for Out-of-Distribution Reasoning in LLMs: An Empirical Study on Diagnosis-Related Group Coding
arxiv-2505-21908.creator: Hanyin Wang, Zhenbang Wu, Gururaj Kolar, Hariprasad Korsapati, Brian Bartlett, Bryan Hull, Jimeng Sun
arxiv-2505-21908.description: Abstract Diagnosis-Related Group (DRG) codes are essential for hospital reimbursement and operations but require labor-intensive assignment. Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle with DRG coding due to the out-of-distribution (OOD) nature of the task: pretraining corpora rarely contain private clinical or billing data. We introduce DRG-Sapphire , which uses large-scale reinforcement learning (RL) for automated DRG coding from clinical notes.

arxiv-2508-16792.title: Neuromorphic Simulation of Drosophila Melanogaster Brain Connectome on Loihi 2
arxiv-2508-16792.creator: Felix Wang, Bradley H. Theilman, Fred Rothganger, William Severa, Craig M. Vineyard, and James B. Aimone
arxiv-2508-16792.description: Abstract We demonstrate the first-ever nontrivial, biologically realistic connectome simulated on neuromorphic computing hardware. Specifically, we implement the whole-brain connectome of the adult Drosophila melanogaster (fruit fly) from the FlyWire Consortium containing 140K neurons and 50M synapses on the Intel Loihi 2 neuromorphic platform. This task is particularly challenging due to the characteristic connectivity structure of biological networks.

pmc-11366556.title: Latest knowledge on a comprehensive understanding of cervical deformity and selection of effective treatment methods using recent classification systems: a narrative review
pmc-11366556.creator: Seok Woo Kim
pmc-11366556.description: Surgical treatment for patients with cervical spine deformities is challenging for both patients and doctors. For successful surgical treatment, mastery of processes is important to objectively evaluate and classify the degree of deformity. Recently, efforts have been increasing to systematically understand, evaluate, and effectively treat complex cervical spine deformities.

pmc-11637513.title: High traffic roads and adverse birth outcomes: comparing births upwind and downwind of the same road
pmc-11637513.creator: Andrew Larkin, Mary D Willis, Lena Harris, Beate Ritz, Elaine L Hill, Perry Hystad
pmc-11637513.description: Traffic-related air pollution is a major concern for perinatal health. Determining causal associations, however, is difficult because high-traffic areas tend to correspond with lower socioeconomic neighborhoods and other environmental exposures. To overcome confounding, we compared pregnant individuals living downwind and upwind of the same high-traffic road.

pmc-12416328.title: High-grade astrocytoma with piloid features resected with an exoscopic supracerebellar infratentorial approach: illustrative case
pmc-12416328.creator: Franco Rubino, Peter Harris, Abir L. Mukherjee, Walter C. Jean
pmc-12416328.description: BACKGROUNDHigh-grade astrocytoma with piloid features (HGAP) was recently added to the WHO 2021 CNS classification system among the group of circumscribed astrocytic gliomas. These tumors present with high-grade piloid histology with similarities to glioblastoma. HGAPs in the pineal region become particularly challenging due to its deep location and proximity to deep venous structures, the midbrain, and the thalamus.

pmc-12616999.title: LGALS3 promotes liver fibrosis by enhancing the expression and phosphorylation of ERK1/2
pmc-12616999.creator: Xin Zheng, Lu Yang, Wenbin Wang, Jingying Sun, Yue Li
pmc-12616999.description: BackgroundLiver fibrosis represents the common endpoint of numerous chronic liver diseases. Current therapeutic approaches predominantly focus on alleviating symptoms or addressing the underlying causes, with limited options available for reversing fibrosis. Existing antifibrotic drugs often exhibit low efficacy and carry significant side effects, underscoring the urgent need for novel therapeutic targets.

pmc-12686547.title: Reduced Mitochondrial Adenine Nucleotide Translocase 1 (ANT1) Correlates With Aging‐Associated Airway Remodeling
pmc-12686547.creator: Roshani Jha, Jian Shi, Maggie J. Sedgwick, Justin Sui, Timothy E. Corcoran, Corrine R. Kliment
pmc-12686547.description: Aging generates a variety of phenotypes in the lungs with increased alveolar airspaces or emphysema, decreased surface area, and increased disease susceptibility. Senescence, oxidative stress, and mitochondrial dysfunction are known contributory factors. However, the underlying mechanisms promoting unhealthy aging remain unclear. Adenine nucleotide Translocase 1 (ANT1), a mitochondrial ADP/ATP transporter, is important for mitochondrial metabolism.

pmc-13044537.title: Beyond Scars: Development and Validation of a Four-Dimensional Body Image Score for Women with Breast and Gynecological Cancers - A Tunisian Multicenter Study
pmc-13044537.creator: Narjes karmous, Abdennour Karmous, Refka Bouslimi, Wided Mohamed, Massimo Tusconi, Amayra Tannoubi, Mathew Olumide Adebisi, Narjes karmous
pmc-13044537.description: BackgroundBody image disturbances in breast and gynecological cancer survivors involve complex interrelationships between physical changes, sexuality, and self-esteem. Existing tools inadequately capture these multidimensional, cancer-specific concerns. This study developed and validated a Four-Dimensional Body Image Score for women with breast and gynecological Cancers (4D-BISC).MethodsA cross-sectional study was conducted (March–April 2025) across six Tunisian healthcare facilities.

pmc-13234110.title: Machine learning–driven prediction of mechanical properties of lightweight concrete based on experimental data
pmc-13234110.creator: Ahmed M. Gomaa, Mahmoud S. Ahmed, Ehab M. Lotfy, Erfan Abdel-Latif, Abdel-Rahman M. Naguib
pmc-13234110.description: Lightweight concrete (LWC) is increasingly used in structural and non-structural applications due to its ability to reduce self-weight while maintaining adequate mechanical performance. However, predicting the mechanical behavior of EPS-based lightweight concrete remains challenging because of the complex and nonlinear interactions between mix composition, density, curing age, and aggregate–matrix characteristics.

pmc-13239478.title: Low complication and high bone union rates following acute oblique fibular osteotomy with suture ligation prior to closing wedge high tibial osteotomy: A multicenter study of 231 cases
pmc-13239478.creator: Dai Sato, Kazunori Yasuda, Eiji Kondo, Shuken Kai, Koji Yabuuchi, Jun Onodera, Norimasa Iwasaki, Tomonori Yagi
pmc-13239478.description: PurposeFibular shortening is required in lateral closing wedge (LCW) high tibial osteotomy (HTO), yet the safety and healing profile of acute fibular oblique osteotomy with suture ligation (AOOL) remain unclear. This study evaluated complications, union rate, and time to union after AOOL, and identified factors associated with delayed union.
